---
title: "Is `MIX_TN > 10,000` the right 'Large Volume' cut-off? (R)"
output: html_document
---

R twin of `scripts/2026-06-15_large_project_threshold_analysis.py`. Derives where "large"
actually begins from CSI's asphalt-bid tonnage, using the EDA-6411 toolkit. **Reads derived CSVs
only; the live 10k rule is unchanged.**

> Note: `mclust` / `nortest` / `moments` are not installed on this machine, so the GMM is a
> small hand-rolled 2-component EM, skewness is computed by formula, and normality uses
> `shapiro.test` (instead of Anderson–Darling). Results match the Python twin.

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(ggplot2); library(scales); library(cluster)})
BASE <- "/Users/t/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/00 MSBA + Coding/00_summer 2026/00_CSI_ELP/01_Summer_2026"
OUT  <- file.path(BASE, "02_modules/sweet_spot/outputs")
base <- read.csv(file.path(OUT, "2026-06-04_project_base.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
arch <- read.csv(file.path(OUT, "2026-06-04_project_archetypes.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
df <- left_join(base, arch[, c("Contract_Id","rule_archetype")], by = "Contract_Id")
df$is_bid <- toupper(trimws(df$CSI_Participated)) == "TRUE"
bid <- df %>% filter(MIX_TN_num > 0, is_bid)
m   <- bid$MIX_TN_num
m_all <- df$MIX_TN_num[df$MIX_TN_num > 0]
logm <- log10(m)
CURRENT <- 10000
cat(sprintf("asphalt bids: %d | market w/ asphalt: %d\n", length(m), length(m_all)))
```

### (1) Distribution & skew

```{r dist}
skew <- function(x){ mu<-mean(x); (sum((x-mu)^3)/length(x)) / (sum((x-mu)^2)/length(x))^1.5 }
print(round(summary(m)))
cat("skew raw =", round(skew(m),2), " skew log =", round(skew(logm),2), "\n")
print(round(quantile(m, c(.10,.25,.50,.75,.90,.95,.99))))
cat(sprintf(">>> 10k = %.0fth pctile; %.0f%% of bids exceed it\n",
            mean(m < CURRENT)*100, mean(m > CURRENT)*100))
```

### (2) Log-normality (shapiro on log10 — AD substitute)

```{r lognorm}
print(shapiro.test(logm))
cat("log is far less skewed than raw -> do break-finding on the log scale\n")
```

### (3) Upper-tail fences (1.5xIQR, mean+3sd)

```{r fences}
q <- quantile(m, c(.25,.75)); iqr <- q[2]-q[1]
iqr_fence <- as.numeric(q[2] + 1.5*iqr)
sigma3_log <- 10^(mean(logm) + 3*sd(logm))
cat(sprintf("1.5xIQR fence: %s   mean+3sd(log): %s (degenerate on heavy tail)\n",
            comma(round(iqr_fence)), comma(round(sigma3_log))))
```

### (4) Natural breaks — K-means + silhouette

```{r kmeans}
set.seed(42); xs <- scale(logm)
best_k <- 2; best_s <- -1; best_km <- NULL
for (k in 2:5) {
  km <- kmeans(xs, centers = k, nstart = 25)
  s <- mean(silhouette(km$cluster, dist(xs))[, 3])
  cat(sprintf("  k=%d silhouette=%.3f\n", k, s))
  if (s > best_s) { best_s <- s; best_k <- k; best_km <- km }
}
ctr <- sort(10^(best_km$centers * attr(xs,"scaled:scale") + attr(xs,"scaled:center")))
kmeans_break <- 10^((log10(ctr[length(ctr)]) + log10(ctr[length(ctr)-1]))/2)
cat(sprintf("-> k=%d; top-two break = %s TN\n", best_k, comma(round(kmeans_break))))
```

### (4b) GMM by hand-rolled 2-component EM (mclust unavailable)

```{r gmm}
em2 <- function(x, iters = 300) {
  mu <- as.numeric(quantile(x, c(.25,.75))); s <- c(sd(x), sd(x)); p <- c(.5,.5)
  for (i in 1:iters) {
    d1 <- p[1]*dnorm(x,mu[1],s[1]); d2 <- p[2]*dnorm(x,mu[2],s[2]); r <- d2/(d1+d2)
    p[2] <- mean(r); p[1] <- 1-p[2]
    mu[2] <- sum(r*x)/sum(r);  mu[1] <- sum((1-r)*x)/sum(1-r)
    s[2] <- sqrt(sum(r*(x-mu[2])^2)/sum(r)); s[1] <- sqrt(sum((1-r)*(x-mu[1])^2)/sum(1-r))
  }
  list(mu=mu, s=s, p=p)
}
fit <- em2(logm)
grid <- seq(min(logm), max(logm), length.out = 4000)
post2 <- fit$p[2]*dnorm(grid,fit$mu[2],fit$s[2]) /
         (fit$p[1]*dnorm(grid,fit$mu[1],fit$s[1]) + fit$p[2]*dnorm(grid,fit$mu[2],fit$s[2]))
gmm_cross <- 10^(grid[which(post2 > .5)[1]])
cat(sprintf("two-mode means (TN): %s ; crossover = %s  (≈10k validates the floor)\n",
            paste(comma(round(10^fit$mu)), collapse=" / "), comma(round(gmm_cross))))
```

### (5) Does behavior shift at 10k? Outcome by tonnage band

```{r bands}
bid <- bid %>% mutate(
  is_win_well = CSI_Bid_Quality %in% c("Excellent Win","Acceptable Win"),
  is_bomb = CSI_Bid_Quality == "Bomb",
  band = cut(MIX_TN_num, c(0,5000,10000,20000,40000,Inf),
             labels=c("<5k","5-10k","10-20k","20-40k",">40k"), right=FALSE))
bid %>% group_by(band) %>% summarise(n=n(),
  win_well=round(mean(is_win_well)*100,1), bomb=round(mean(is_bomb)*100,1),
  med_mix=round(median(MIX_TN_num)), .groups="drop") %>% as.data.frame() %>% print()
cat(">>> win-well flat to 40k then JUMPS to ~24% -> edge is at ~40k, not 10k\n")
```

### (6) Is "large" state-relative?

```{r regional}
bid %>% group_by(State) %>% summarise(n=n(), median=median(MIX_TN_num),
  p90=quantile(MIX_TN_num,.9), .groups="drop") %>% filter(n>=10) %>%
  arrange(desc(median)) %>% as.data.frame() %>% print()
```

### (7) Candidate thresholds vs the current 10k

```{r candidates}
p <- quantile(m, c(.75,.90))
cand <- tibble::tibble(
  candidate = c("Current 10k","P75","P90","1.5xIQR","K-means","GMM"),
  threshold = round(c(CURRENT, p[1], p[2], iqr_fence, kmeans_break, gmm_cross)))
cand$pctile_bid <- round(sapply(cand$threshold, function(t) mean(m < t)*100))
cand$pct_bid_above <- round(sapply(cand$threshold, function(t) mean(m > t)*100), 1)
print(as.data.frame(cand))
```

### (8) Figure — distribution + outcome shift

```{r figs, fig.width=10, fig.height=4}
ggplot(data.frame(m), aes(m)) +
  geom_histogram(bins=40, fill="#2c7fb8", alpha=.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=10000, color="#d73027", linetype="dashed", linewidth=1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=kmeans_break, color="#1a9850", linetype="dashed") +
  scale_x_log10(labels=comma) +
  labs(title="MIX_TN (CSI asphalt bids) — 10k vs K-means break", x="MIX_TN (log10)", y="count") +
  theme_minimal(base_size=12)

bid %>% group_by(band) %>% summarise(`win-well`=mean(is_win_well)*100, bomb=mean(is_bomb)*100, .groups="drop") %>%
  pivot_longer(-band) %>%
  ggplot(aes(band, value, fill=name)) + geom_col(position="dodge") +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("win-well"="#1a9850","bomb"="#d73027"), name=NULL) +
  labs(title="Outcome by tonnage band — the shift is at >40k", x="MIX_TN band", y="% of bids") +
  theme_minimal(base_size=12)
```

### (9) Light data check for the OTHER archetypes' cut-offs

```{r other-rules}
q <- df %>% filter(toupper(trimws(has_quantity))=="TRUE" | has_quantity==TRUE)
cat("n_mat_types (Complex uses >=5):\n"); print(table(q$n_mat_types))
cat("  share >=5:", round(mean(q$n_mat_types>=5)*100,1), "%  (>=4 would be",
    round(mean(q$n_mat_types>=4)*100,1), "%)\n")
g <- q$prop_GRADE_CY[!is.na(q$prop_GRADE_CY) & q$prop_GRADE_CY>0]
cat("prop_GRADE_CY where>0: P50/P75/P90 =", round(quantile(g, c(.5,.75,.9)),2), "\n")
bs <- ifelse(is.na(q$prop_BASE_TN),0,q$prop_BASE_TN) + ifelse(is.na(q$prop_SHLDR_TN),0,q$prop_SHLDR_TN)
cat("base+shoulder >=0.60:", sum(bs>=.6), " also mix<0.20:",
    sum(bs>=.6 & ifelse(is.na(q$prop_MIX_TN),0,q$prop_MIX_TN)<.2), "\n")
```

## Takeaway

- **10k is the natural small/large seam** (GMM crossover ≈ 9.2k) — keep it as the floor.
- The **competitive edge is at ~40k** (win-well 11% → 24%) → propose a **Major tier**.
- "Large" is **state-relative** (ND ~9k vs SD ~30k).
